feature_definition: RATIO_TT_DET = TT_mean / %DET. TT_mean = mean length of qualifying vertical lines (l>=l_min=2, main diagonal excluded) — RQA trapping time notion. %DET = (sum of diagonal-line points for qualifying diagonal lines l>=l_min, k!=0) / offdiag recurrence sum. Delay embedding m=2 tau=1 over trailing window W_RR=168, L-inf recurrence with eps=EPS_SCALE*std(window); causal trailing only; fail-closed to NaN/no-signal if %DET<=0, no qualifying diagonal lines/offdiag degenerate, TT_mean undefined/non-finite, or recurrence degenerate.
